# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_WITH_VWAP_RETEST

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A gap up that fails to hold and retraces to VWAP often reverses, providing a short‑biased fade opportunity. This edge exists because initial gap-up momentum frequently exhausts, causing price to revert to the intraday fair value (VWAP) where short-side liquidity pools form as traders who missed the gap look to enter short on the retest.

## Mechanism

Entry: If the open gaps up >0.5% from prior close AND price subsequently retraces to within 0.1% of VWAP AND forms a bearish candle (close < open) that closes below VWAP, enter short at the candle close. Exit: chart-stop at the high of the gap bar, TP1 at 1.5R (risk = entry to gap bar high), runner trail 12% off HWM. Regime filters: only active when VIX <18 and ribbon width is not increasing >0.002; avoid when VIX >22 or strong upward ribbon alignment (ribbon width increasing >0.002 with fast EMA > slow EMA).
